q: Bernoulli's equation can be derived using the ________ principle to a fluid flowing in a tube. 2025
e: Bernoulli's equation is derived from the work-energy principle applied to fluid flow.

q: Which of the following is the SI unit of surface tension? 2026
e: Surface tension is force per unit length, so its SI unit is newton per metre.

q: The viscosity of liquids ________ with an increase in temperature. 2026
e: An increase in temperature reduces intermolecular forces in liquids, thereby decreasing viscosity.

q: The force between molecules of same substance is called ________. 2026
e: Cohesion is the force of attraction between molecules of the same substance.
Hydraulic brake fluid must be non-compressible to transmit pressure effectively.

q: Adhesion refers to forces between molecules of ________ substance. 2025
e: Adhesion is the attraction force between molecules of different substances.

q: Surface tension can also be referred to as a force because it is the tension between ________ molecules. 2025
e: Surface tension results from cohesive forces between liquid molecules at the surface.

q: What does high viscosity indicate about a fluid? 2025
e: Viscosity measures fluid friction, so high viscosity indicates strong internal friction.

q: The speed of water spraying from a hose ________ by making the hose area smaller. 2025
e: According to the equation of continuity, reducing cross-sectional area increases fluid speed.

q: Why does a river flow faster when passing through a narrow section (defile)? 2025
e: The equation of continuity is derived from the conservation of mass, making flow speed increase when the area decreases.

q: Which law expresses the drag force resisting the fall of small spherical objects through a fluid medium under the influence of gravity? 2025
e: Stokes' law gives the expression for viscous drag force on small spherical bodies.

q: Which of the following is the SI unit of surface tension? 2025
e: Surface tension is force per unit length, expressed in newton per metre.

q: The viscosity of ________ increases with an increase in temperature. 2025
e: Unlike liquids, gas viscosity increases with temperature due to increased molecular momentum transfer.

q: The drag force resisting the fall of small spherical objects through a fluid medium is expressed by ________. 2025
e: Stokes' law defines the viscous drag force acting on a sphere moving through a fluid.

q: Due to capillary action, a liquid will rise in a tube, if the angle of contact is ________. 2025
e: A liquid rises in a capillary tube when the contact angle is acute (less than 90°).

q: Cohesion refers to forces between molecules of ________ substance. 2025
e: Cohesive forces act between identical molecules of the same substance.

q: Adhesion refers to forces between molecules of ________ substances. 2026
e: Adhesive forces exist between molecules of different substances.

q: What makes a small insect able to walk on the surface of water? 2026
e: Surface tension creates a film-like effect on water that supports light objects like insects.

q: Which of the following is a characteristic assumption of an ideal laminar fluid flow? 2026
e: Ideal fluid flow is assumed to be non-viscous (zero viscosity) and incompressible.
